decisions.reason: Healthcare and hospitality recruitment lies far from the firm's maritime knowledge base, so the firm can hardly interpret results or improve it, and its resources fit better in the core expansion toward integrated maritime solutions.
Superyacht crew recruitment draws directly on the firm's crewing network and seafarer know-how, letting it absorb market feedback and refine the service.

The Smart Academy builds on the firm's training centres, has a dedicated page and a growing network of partner institutions, and that cooperation with research and education bodies extends the firm's related knowledge.
FuelEU emissions monitoring is close to core technical management, is driven by regulation, and has shown concrete success in meeting the submission deadline.
The dashboard is integrated into the firm's own PAL software and supports its digital and environmental strategy, which the firm's own R&D can keep developing.
The cost simulator complements the FuelEU services within the firm's own software and builds on its compliance know-how, though it may later be merged into the dashboard.
